what: Gate B semantic dedup-sweep can strip optional size trailers after apply
scenario_or_breakage: The plan requires preserving `diff_added` / `diff_deleted` / `mechanical_churn` on Gate B apply and on Gate A/B direct rewrites, but `### Shared post-apply pipeline` still runs an LLM dedup rewrite (steps 1–3) before `ACTION=EMIT_PLAN` and Step 2b.5. That sweep can drop trailers as “redundant” prose (e.g. a `mechanical_churn: true` line echoed in Failure modes), restoring legacy `diff_lines > 1500` hardness or dropping the mechanical advisory without any preservation check.
suggested_fix: Exempt the final contiguous metadata block immediately above required `diff_lines:` from semantic dedup, or rerun the same snapshot/strict-trailer validation after dedup and before `ACTION=EMIT_PLAN`; mirror the carve-out in `skills/design/SKILL.md` Gate B surfaces.
